historical_K4V.warning: On a different previously consumed K4R FIT stream, Yggdrasil failed to voluntarily select action 1 despite authentic samples; this diagnostic does not imply K4U learned DEV action traces are available.

diagnostics.fit: Analyze all 6,114 original K4U public before/action/after/reward transitions in process A and process B, per-family positive/nonzero reward frequency, terminal-success share, training-action coverage, progress toward goal signs, blocked-front rate, public observation feature collision/conflict.
diagnostics.dev: Compare 8 genuine original heldout per-policy world outcomes per family (success, timeouts, actual reward, steps, only retained first actions). Never assert unseen per-step development action frequencies: original K4U stored their trace SHA256, not the individual action trace.
diagnostics.counterfactuals: NONE: no modifying FIT labels, no new policies, no fake source states, no re-running seeds, no prediction of counterfactual success from aggregated results.
diagnostics.attribution: Classify confirmed reward sparsity and lack of goal completion as observations. Distinguish underdetermined causal explanations (insufficient local representation, temporal credit, wrong exploration, no multi-step planning), and explicitly mark inability to attribute primary causal failure from saved records.
diagnostics.negative_controls: Show same-FIT conventional Q succeeds on Empty but fails on FourRooms, learned dynamics+BFS succeeds on both; neither alone establishes a native cognitive architecture's mechanism deficit.
diagnostics.constraints: Require K4U cross-process comparator exact science agreement, original FIT 48 episodes and 6114 transitions each, original native checkpoint auth, fully matched new DEV control records and K4U NO_GO in both, frozen native source pins, all SHA256 matches. Fail closed before analyzing if any mismatch.
diagnostics.mandatory_verdict: RETROSPECTIVE_FAILURE_FACTORS_IDENTIFIED_WITH_CAUSAL_LIMITS; K4U scientific NO_GO unchanged; no new first-use positive.

next_prospective: Only if genuinely new mechanism-level hypothesis independently authored and preregistered: test sparse-reward causal credit or planned state representation in fresh interactive world families with equally informed matched simple recurrent/Q and dynamics+BFS baselines; full observation/final transition and CPU/memory/energy budget; freeze unfamiliar DEV worlds before learning. Do not use K4U DEV to tune method or select hyperparameters.
